name: Bloody Cleaver
upgradeable: Fusible to Crippling Cleaver Maiming Cleaver Vengeful Cleaver Vampiric Cleaver

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +4 Enhancement Bonus : +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Bleeding
effects.tooltip: Bleeding 3 : This weapon is wickedly curved, with spines and hooks meant to cause damage to those with flesh. This weapon does 3d8 bleeding damage to those that are vulnerable to it.

effects.name: Humanoid Bane
effects.tooltip: Humanoid Bane 3 : This weapon is attuned specifically to those that walk among us, dealing an additional 3d10 bane damage vs. Humanoids.

effects.name: Bodyfeeder
effects.tooltip: Bodyfeeder : Whenever a bodyfeeder weapon you wield scores a critical hit, you gain 15 temporary hit points that last for up to 1 minute.

effects.name: Fusible
effects.tooltip: Fusible : Something about this item looks incomplete. Perhaps in the future it will be compatible with another item to create a brand-new fusion of the two.

flavor_text: This large blade was once wielded handily by one of the Droaam Army's half-orc chefs. As one can imagine, it's very well-sharpened and has been used to carry out many a gruesome deed.

source.raw: Frame Work , End chests, Dorris ' chests
